introduction: Explore the mist, elemental shrines, titan palace and cloud camps. Twenty independent deliveries cover the siren, seven bounty proofs, nine treasures, the competing titan token and Pure-Dark. Twelve preparation/access services explain the longer routes. Active, ready accounting is required; missing reward, guarded fees and source/access qualification remain explicit.
orientation: The mountain peak reaches the outside portal room. Enter the local arrival portal to reach the mist; the reciprocal arrival portal returns outside. Enter Shiva's pool for the icy cloud, touch the palace loom for the prison corridor, and enter the fiery cave portal for the foreign Great Below. These are real item teleport routes; knowing a clue or carrying a key does not prove successful travel.

One nexus cloud buys the wispy palace key. One giant badge buys the cloudy prison key, which opens both locked cells beyond the loom passage. These two access services do not award achievements. The named prison key is not the palace key or Raith's blood-red eyepiece, and neither key receipt proves freeing a giant.

The siren accepts four distinct elemental tokens together, gives dress and harp, then vanishes. The shrine chancellors wear the tokens. One accepted bundle owns the outcome; it does not require four personal kills or confirm peace for the sisters.

The hunter accepts seven different hearts independently, including Sealot's foreign heart. Delivery proof is not a recorded personal kill. The Relazier heart request names a reward absent from current world data and needs repair before a safe attempt; material readiness cannot certify payout. Rare holding sources may wander and do not guarantee encounter or repeatable availability.

Wicks has nine independent cash-reward curiosity requests. Distinguish the local single golden horseshoe from Moria's full set, the Harpy Heights wyvern egg from the exotic surface egg, and a smoke egg from both. Ivory, feather and disc are container contents; the horseshoe, bone statue and smoke egg are ground declarations. Recovery and falls need separate care.

The shared Riser mace feeds fire or frost crafting. Fire needs the prison demon's trapped claw; frost needs an icicle reached through Shiva's pool. Each mace plus its own mist shard and 50000 copper becomes a different longsword. Both swords plus the generic dragon scale and 200000 copper make Dusk and Dawn. Starting from Riser requires two maces, two shards and 300000 copper; one-copy source caps and mode-one empty-zone resets prevent a promise of fresh same-visit supply.

Six item-and-coin crafting recipes remain guarded with accounting active. The generic dragon scale's automatic death source is also disabled under active accounting. Support receipts cannot pay fees or replace consumed inputs, and no all-stage crafting achievement is inferred. Item-only crafting services remain distinct from the twenty quest outcomes.

Emition also turns the foreign electrum chunk into the first angelic flute. Return it to Whetstone in the Airship Graveyard for his separate outcome and a different same-named flute. Reln's jade warsuit needs the foreign jade wyrmscale and 10000000 copper; local celestial/smoke scales and generic dragon scale are distinct.

Leolan and Raith both accept the same titan token in independent exchanges. One physical token is consumed by one recipient; earlier history or allegiance does not produce a replacement. Raith's eyepiece is equipment and is not a requirement for the fiery portal. The native recipes do not enforce a good/evil campaign branch.

Relazier accepts foreign Pure-Dark for Purelight and retires, which can remove the bounty heart he carries. These independent outcomes need a deliberate episode/branch policy before becoming a personal campaign. Departure text does not record a returned warlock, royal power drain, released prisoners, invasion or war victory.

Ordinary Emition shop/forge and Snent encrust teaching have shared bindings and separate accounting/actor requirements. No additional custom local quest terminal is bound. Dialogue remains useful guidance; each keyword, source encounter, trap, door, teleport, kill or container inspection needs accepted evidence before it can become its own tracked objective.
